transcript: First day at the new job and it was a total whirlwind, so many names and logins and forms I could barely keep track. My new manager Halima was really welcoming though, took me around to meet the whole team personally instead of just leaving me at a desk. Came home completely fried but in a good way, feels like it could be a good fit.
